exposure: gestational age at birth (preterm vs. term)
cohort: 3,909 twins (22.61% SGA, 77.39% AGA) aged 0-1 year, whose data were collected from the Child Health Care System.
finding: While physical growth parameters (WAZ, LAZ, HCZ) for both SGA and AGA twins reach the normal range by one year of age, they do not achieve the average level of normal singleton children, with SGA twins, especially preterm SGA, showing persistently lower growth levels.
birth_weight: Small for Gestational Age (SGA) and Appropriate for Gestational Age (AGA)
